title: Choti Diwali ka Yam Deepak
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Choti Diwali: Yam ka deepak kyun?

scenes.prompt: Close-up portrait of blue-skinned Lord Krishna with a peacock-feather crown and gentle smile, face in the middle of the frame, surrounded by glowing diyas on Choti Diwali evening, warm golden light
scenes.tts: छोटी दिवाली! इस दिन यमराज के नाम का दीपक क्यों जलाते हैं?
scenes.sub: Choti Diwali! Is din Yamraj ke naam ka deepak kyun jalate hain?
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and a few marigold petals drift slowly in the background, the face stays still and serene

scenes.prompt: An Indian family courtyard before sunrise, a devotee taking a holy morning bath with water from a brass pot, soft dawn light, diyas glowing nearby
scenes.tts: मान्यता है कि इस दिन सूर्योदय से पहले स्नान का विशेष महत्व है।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai ki is din suryoday se pehle snan ka vishesh mahatva hai.

scenes.prompt: A woman lighting a row of fourteen clay diyas filled with mustard oil on a house doorstep at dusk, warm glowing flames, plain stone steps
scenes.tts: शाम को घर में चौदह दीपक जलाने की परंपरा है।
scenes.sub: Shaam ko ghar mein chaudah deepak jalane ki parampara hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker gently and the warm light softly pulses

scenes.prompt: A single clay diya placed at the doorstep at twilight, flame glowing, calm evening sky, house door decorated with marigold garland
scenes.tts: इनके साथ एक दीपक यमराज के लिए भी रखा जाता है, सरसों के तेल का।
scenes.sub: Inke saath ek deepak Yamraj ke liye bhi rakha jaata hai, sarson ke tel ka.
scenes.animate: the single diya flame flickers softly and the evening light gently glows

scenes.prompt: A joyful Indian family standing together at their lit doorway on Diwali eve, diyas glowing all around, warm festive atmosphere, peaceful faces
scenes.tts: कई घरों में यह दीपक धनतेरस पर भी जलाया जाता है।
scenes.sub: Kai gharon mein yeh deepak Dhanteras par bhi jalaya jaata hai.

scenes.prompt: Close-up of blue-skinned Lord Krishna with a peacock-feather crown smiling gently, rows of diyas glowing behind him, golden warm light
scenes.tts: यह परिवार की सुरक्षा और सुख की प्रार्थना का दीपक माना जाता है।
scenes.sub: Yeh parivar ki suraksha aur sukh ki prarthana ka deepak mana jaata hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames behind flicker softly, the face stays still and serene, a few petals drift in the background

scenes.tts: शुभ छोटी दिवाली! लाइक करें, शेयर करें, सब्सक्राइब करें। कल दिवाली की कथा, जय श्री कृष्ण!
scenes.sub: Shubh Choti Diwali! Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Kal Diwali ki katha, Jai Shri Krishna!
